title: Container forest and ancestry proof
description: Implement deterministic parent resolution, ancestor chains, cycle/reference diagnostics, and structural renderer invariants for the Container forest.
completion_criteria: Multiple roots and parent:null are supported.
Unknown parents, cycles, and multiple structural parents are rejected.
Ancestor ordering is stable and covered by fixtures.
Rendered sibling Containers do not overlap and descendants remain contained.
triage_notes: DONE (Codex): added analyzeContainerForest() as the deterministic structural proof for canonical Containers, with authored-order roots/children, root-first ancestor chains, duplicate and multiple-parent rejection, unknown Container/Resource parent diagnostics, and cycle diagnostics. Added validateContainerLayout() for renderer-owned sibling overlap/clearance and descendant containment checks. Fixtures cover multiple roots, parent:null, malformed forests, stable ancestry, manual geometry failures, and nested geometry emitted by computeTopologyLayout(). Verification: npm run typecheck; focused topology tests (20 passing); npm run build.
